open.said: One game this week with something said about it: New England at Chicago, read for what San Francisco wanted from it, a Chicago win.

game.said: New England at Chicago. Chicago won, which is the result San Francisco wanted.

bites.transcript: They have to go for it here, there's no world where you punt from the forty-five.

play.text: (11:35) (Shotgun) pass short middle intended for the tight end INCOMPLETE, broken up at the line.

setup.said: Eleven thirty-five in the first, New England facing fourth and five at the Chicago forty-five, nothing on the board yet.

happened.said: They went for it and were stopped. Chicago takes over on downs.

answer.said: You said there's no world where you punt. Home has seen a few hundred fourth-and-fives, and a bit under half were converted. Tied, first quarter, midfield: I'd have punted, but it's close.

bites.transcript: Picked off, and he's gone the other way, that's the game right there.

play.text: (6:12) (Shotgun) pass deep left INTERCEPTED at the CHI 20, returned 80 yards for a TOUCHDOWN.

setup.said: Six twelve left, New England down three, second and eight at the Chicago thirty-five.

answer.said: A pick returned the length of the field late in a one-score game is rare: home has seen only a handful this season.

bites.transcript: I couldn't watch the last two minutes, honestly.

setup.said: After the final, a bite home matched to no play.

answer.said: What was at stake was a game and a half in the standings for San Francisco, so the nerves were earned.

halftime.said: At the half, Chicago led. Here is what came after the break.

close.said: That was the week: three bites on one game, a decision, a celebration and the nerves at the end.
